Draft publication checks shape only, not truth or generated code. Preserve human edits and notes. Publish the entire requested deliverable in one call: body is a complete document, not an append operation or a one-block patch. Include all supplied tasks, owners, deadlines and constraints before saving. structured_table fields declare stable key,label,type,editable and explicit decimal scale/units or enum choices. Decimal cells are strings; row_id is stable; null means missing. Custom views contain bounded inert source {html,css,js}, readable fallback, current access_generation, exact bindable_artifacts references and declared read_binding actions with payload_schema {type:"object",properties:{},additionalProperties:false}. Source UTF-8 total <=48000 bytes, serialized body <=96000 bytes, bound bodies together <=48000 JSON bytes. Generated source runs only in the untrusted opaque-origin no-network frontend sandbox, never the backend. No fetch, credentials, provider, arbitrary target, save or approval action exists. Read actions return the exact saved document or structured table, not the latest replacement; revisions require a new binding. Preserve stable identities and human work. Agent-owned preparation can advance through immutable worker revisions without approval; human-edited or human-accepted work changes only through proposals. A protected_note label protects its exact content but is not evidence of human acceptance. Artifact creation is useful draft work, not verification: do not assert execution, correctness or goal satisfaction. Use empty success_criteria for these drafts; only shape is checked. The existing sandbox bootstrap provides window.workagent.ready() (a promise resolving initial plain JSON, normally an empty object), window.workagent.data, and window.workagent.request(actionName, {}) (a promise resolving the broker response with binding, artifact_id, revision_id, body_hash and body). This lets an explicit human rebind reuse the same presentation without granting access to arbitrary data. Never substitute data yourself or retry against another target when a read is refused; structured table rows contain cells:[{field_key,value}], not a values object. No fetch, imports, packages or external assets. DOM state is ephemeral; durable changes use trusted shell human-save/proposal controls.
